cc:Work.dc:description: Report-derived min-max ranges, not confidence intervals. History is restored as a synthetic snapshot; the full 128K history is not sent to the LLM. Correct-State padding and fixed Top-k=5 limit generalization. Sources: docs/experiments/reports/long-horizon-analysis-2026-11-11.md; docs/experiments/reports/state-update-h100-analysis-2026-11-11.md
